title: qed spec
description: Typed spec-driven development — acceptance criteria with deterministic verification.

worker.description: Configuration for the worker. If present, qed runs in worker loop mode (iterate until criteria pass). If absent, qed runs in verify mode (single-pass verification). At least one of 'command' or 'prompt' is required.

command.description: Shell command to run the worker. For agent workers (prompt present), defaults to Claude CLI. For script workers (no prompt), required. The command receives the prompt via $QED_WORKER_PROMPT env var.

prompt.description: Prompt for the worker agent. When present, this is agent invocation — qed manages the prompt (appends failure feedback on retries) and passes it via $QED_WORKER_PROMPT env var. When absent, the command has full control (script worker).

model.description: Model to use for agent workers. Only used when prompt is present.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this criterion verifies.

verify.description: How to verify this criterion. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

oneOf.description: Run a shell command and check the exit code.
Spawn an independent LLM agent to review against a prompt.

model.description: Model to use for the review.

command.description: Shell command to invoke the agent. Receives prompt via $QED_VERIFIER_PROMPT. Defaults to Claude CLI.

run.description: Shell command to run property tests.

target.description: Fully qualified name of the theorem to verify.

oneOf.description: Ask a human to verify. Requires interactive stdin (schedule defaults to 'manual').

schedule.description: When this criterion runs. Defaults: 'always' for command/property/proof, 'heavy' for agent, 'manual' for human.

skip.description: Skip this criterion with the given reason. Skipped criteria show [SKIP] in output and do not affect the overall pass/fail result.

maxIterations.description: Maximum worker iterations before giving up. Only valid when worker is present.

stuckThreshold.description: Consecutive identical failures before declaring stuck. Only valid when worker is present.

then.description: Worker loop mode: worker iterates against criteria.

else.description: Verify mode: single-pass verification, criteria required.
